findings.source_quote: ὡς γλίχεσθαι πάντα ἄνθρωπον τῶν ἐκεῖ ἐπιδημησάντων σαρκῶν αὐτῶν ἀπογεύσασθαί σου
findings.english_quote: every person staying there is himself eager to taste your flesh.
findings.issue: The attachment of αὐτῶν is not adequately disclosed. The draft's emphasis on the people is defensible if this genitive plural is attached back to τῶν ἐκεῖ ἐπιδημησάντων; it is not directly an intensifier agreeing with the accusative singular πάντα ἄνθρωπον. A competing attachment to σαρκῶν yields an emphasis such as 'to taste your very flesh.' The existing note mentions the people's own flesh as an alternative but does not preserve this viable flesh-emphasis reading or explain the grammatical attachment supporting 'himself.' This is an ordinary attachment ambiguity, not evidence of defective print.
findings.suggested_revision: Expand the note to explain the proposed backward attachment of αὐτῶν to τῶν ἐκεῖ ἐπιδημησάντων and give a contextual reason for choosing it. Explicitly compare it with the closer attachment to σαρκῶν, represented by 'every person staying there is eager to taste your very flesh.' Either defensible choice may be retained after the revised wording and disclosure receive fresh review.

findings.source_quote: μέχρις ἂν εἰδῶμεν εἰ τῆς κατὰ σοῦ διαβολῆς ἐκείνου ἀπόντος ὑπολῆσαι δυνήσονται
findings.english_quote: until we know whether, in his absence, they will be able to subside from his slander against you.
findings.issue: The main text assigns ὑπολῆσαι a cessation sense that has not been established. The draft itself acknowledges this evidentiary deficiency, and the surrounding account of hostility cannot by itself establish the printed infinitive's meaning or its construction with τῆς κατὰ σοῦ διαβολῆς. The note honestly identifies the problem, but cannot license an unsupported main rendering. Coverage of the surviving wording and the eleven-dot printed gap elsewhere in this passage is present; the remaining block is unsupported lexical meaning, not missing print verification or the mere existence of alternative interpretations.
findings.suggested_revision: Retain the supplied reading ὑπολῆσαι. Obtain a documented morphological and lexical analysis, with relevant usage supporting both the proposed sense and the genitive construction. If cessation is established, also determine whether the clause means ceasing the slander itself or subsiding from its effects before revising the English. If no defensible analysis is available, keep the passage blocked. Any proposed correction must be explicitly distinguished from the verified printed reading, and any replacement English must undergo fresh review.
